INSERT_AFTER <DonorType>#<regex> -> \n-separated lines inserted after the one matched line (relocate mode only: the explicit constructor the exported-module lint demands). SKIP: donor file not relocated, with its owner or reason. NEC: equivalence not decided (hashes, dates and the suggestion recorded).
